Not exercised by this topology:

  - storage-array or filesystem snapshot primitives
  - third-party backup products and their agents
  - immutable off-account object-lock targets
  - customer-scale data volumes
  - multi-node or cross-availability-zone recovery

a paging system wired to that rota

a documented decision on whether an incident is notifiable

notifications.body:
This is a DRILL. Your data was not affected and no action is required.

Had this been real, the recovery would have restored your data to the most recent backup. Backups are taken every 24h00m00.00s, so up to that much recent work would not have been recovered and would need to be re-entered.

Service was restored to a verified state in 0.08s.

The restored data was checked against its cryptographic signature before being brought back, and its integrity was verified as intact.
